title: Choose Aether's visual world
question: The roll dealt Liquid Light Show. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Liquid Light Show
options.lineage: 1960s concert light shows: oil and dye in glass dishes on an overhead projector
options.thesis: Every song gets its own light show, mixed live by how you listen.
materials: oil and dye in clock glass
projector light on a dark wall
options.viewport: The whole screen is the projected wall; your Sound Shape sits in the dish at centre, pushing dye outward with the bass, title and transport set low.
options.risk: If the dye blurs into soft gradients it becomes a screensaver; edges must stay hard.

raised.raise: Colours displace, never blend: dye fields keep hard edges and push each other into rings.
Every point of the Sound Shape carries its value pinned on a leader line.
Absence is drawn: the shape's full reach is a ghost outline, so zero looks deliberate.
Browsing packs cover art edge to edge in whole cells; tracks you love get circled.
Plain, literal labels: every control is named for what it does to the sound.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Your Sound Shape is a constellation charted on an engraved sky map.
options.viewport: A rotating planisphere fills the screen; the shape's seven stars sit on it, the song's position traced as an orbit.
options.risk: The obvious reading of the name 'Aether': space themes are where most runs land.

options.label: Floated Pigment
options.lineage: ebru marbling on a thickened bath
options.thesis: The song is a pigment bath; shaping the sound combs the colour, and saving lifts a one-off print of your taste.
options.viewport: A full-bleed bath; dragging a shape point combs a stroke through the colour.
options.case: Holds product clarity (saving a shape as a unique print maps well), but listeners know concert light shows better than marbling.
options.risk: Reads as craft-fair rather than music without strong audio reactivity.

options.label: Seven-Segment
options.thesis: BPM, time and shape values lit as segment digits.
options.viewport: Giant segment digits for time and tempo.
options.case: Numbers are clear but the shape itself has no home; not dreamy.
options.kept: Absence is designed: the shape's ghost outline.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.thesis: Sound parameters as cords in tension.
options.case: Engineering register misses the dreamy brief.
options.kept: Values pinned to nodes on leader lines.

options.label: Event Catalog
options.thesis: Tracks as stamp-size thumbnails in a numbered grid.
options.case: Great for browsing, silent on the sound.
options.kept: Dense whole-cell cover grid; loved tracks circled.

options.label: Quote Grammar
options.thesis: Every control named in quotes, hazard stripes.
options.case: Ironic register fights the dreamy brief.

options.label: Choice Frame
options.thesis: Taste setup as branching choice cards.
options.case: Fits only the onboarding; timer bars break accessibility.
options.kept: Taste choices bloom outward as cards (no timer).

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark streaming-app player, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Big cover art, title, scrubber, transport, an EQ sheet.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the apps you said you don't want.
